strategies.name: opening_range_breakout_retest_with_session_bias
strategies.entry_summary: Determine directional bias from the 7:00 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. 1-hour candles using an engulfing pattern before the New York session; then on the 5-minute chart mark the 9:30-9:45 opening range and wait for price to break and close outside the range in the bias direction. Enter on the retrace into a PO
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop beyond the invalidation area, typically below the opening range or below the demand/support level for buys, and above the recent wick/supply area for sells. Take profit at the next meaningful opposing level seen to the left, such as a supply/resistance zone for buys or lower target/TP

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches one opening-range breakout/retest strategy skeleton with directional buy/sell applications and compatible entry/management variants (POI choice, passive limit vs retest confirmation, fixed target area vs manual break-even management), not separate opposing strategies because direction is selected by the same bias framework.
